packageRules.description: Patch updates merge themselves. Only updates that merge themselves follow main: its ruleset wants an up-to-date head, and every other pull request would run the CI again after every push to main (owner, 2026-11-18).
A major update waits for the owner: no pull request before its box in the Dependency Dashboard is ticked (owner, 2026-11-18).
Below 1.0 a minor update counts like a major one (owner, 2026-11-18).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security pull request never waits for an approval in the Dependency Dashboard.

packageRules.description: Security pull requests merge themselves for patch updates (owner, 2026-11-13, #148).
Minor security updates merge themselves from version 1.0 on; below 1.0 a minor update counts like a major one and waits for the owner (#148).
Pin and digest security updates merge themselves too (owner, 2026-11-13, #148).
